dct_description_sm: This dataset consists of 1 .zip archive of XML files and 1 .zip archive of TXT files. Unzipping the archives will create a directory for each year between 2006 - 2015 inclusive.   Inside each folder in the XML directory will be 1 XML file for each debate during that year. The individual file names correspond to an internal numbering convention on line 21 of the document.   Inside the TXT directory will be 1 file for each year. The .txt files are master files containing all of the XML files with the tags removed.
dct_rights_sm: This dataset is made available without information on how it can be used. You should communicate with the Contact(s) specified before use.
